theme: London session candle retest stats — replication of NY intraday series for the London open killzone
session_window: 3:00 - 5:00 AM ET (London 8:00-10:00 AM, classic London open killzone)
subject_candles: Six 15-minute candles from 3:00-4:15 ET (covering London open and first hour)
forward_windows: +15 min, +30 min, +45 min after subject candle closes

either_side_retest.description: Probability the high OR low of the subject candle gets touched by a later candle's wick.

both_sides_sweep.description: Probability BOTH the high AND the low of the subject get touched (full sweep).

directional_split.description: Hi-any / Lo-any rates — probability the high (or low) gets touched at all (alone or in combination with the other side).

key_findings.1: The 3:45 ET candle is the strongest London-session magnet. 94.98% retest rate within 15 min of close, 99% within 45 min. This is HIGHER than the NY 9:30 candle's 90.09% retest rate at the same forward window.
key_findings.2: Sweep rate (both sides hit) peaks at the 3:45 candle: 21% by +15 min, 41% by +45 min. Even the +15 sweep rate is 4x higher than other London candles.
key_findings.3: The 3:00 candle (true London open) is the WEAKEST retest at 79.45% by +15 — significantly lower than later London candles. London open establishes a range that holds initially.
key_findings.4: After the 4:00 candle, retest rates drop again. 4:00 has only 17.35% sweep rate by +45, the lowest of the six. The 4:00 zone often establishes a directional move.
key_findings.5: All London candles show a slight HIGH-bias (hi-any > lo-any) except 4:15 which is balanced. NQ's upward drift bias persists through London hours.
key_findings.6: Compared to NY 9:30 (90.09% by +15): London 3:45 retest rate is HIGHER (94.98%). Compared to NY 9:30 sweep rate (15.95% by +30): London 3:45 sweep rate is also HIGHER (32.42%). London session is a more intense magnetic environment than NY open.

comparison_to_ny_session.verdict: London 3:45 candle has higher retest rates than NY 9:30 at every forward window. London open killzone is more 'magnetic' than NY open.

sample_size_caveats: 219 days = ~11 months. Aggregate stats trustworthy to ±3pp. The 99-100% rates are essentially saturated — even with 5pp CI they remain very high probability events.
